criteria.evidence: [OMNI-1][AC-1] service tests in src/pages/tools/string/reverse/OMNI-1.test.ts; they fail on assertions (received 'dlrow gib olleH', not 'world big Hello')
[OMNI-1][AC-1] e2e/OMNI-1.spec.ts; it fails on expect(getByLabel('Reverse word order')).toBeVisible() because the option is not there yet
[OMNI-1][AC-2] service tests; they fail on assertions (received 'owt eno\nruof eerht')
[OMNI-1][AC-2] e2e/OMNI-1.spec.ts; it fails on the toBeVisible expect for the missing option

[OMNI-1][AC-3] service tests; the one with the true case fails (received 'dlroW olleH', not 'World Hello'). The omitted-argument test passes now, as intended, because it only guards existing behaviour.
[OMNI-1][AC-3] e2e/OMNI-1.spec.ts; it fails on the toBeVisible expect for the missing option

cases.expect: 'world big Hello': words in reverse order, letters kept
cases.rules_out: a character reversal ('dlrow gib olleH'), or reversing words and also their letters
swapping only the first and last word, or leaving the middle words in place

cases.data: browser: the option starts unchecked, then check it with 'Hello big world' typed in
cases.rules_out: an option that starts on, or one that is shown but not wired to the result
reversing the words of the whole text ('four three\ntwo one'), or the characters of each line ('owt eno\nruof eerht')

cases.expect: 'c b a\ne d\nf': 3 lines with 3, 2 and 1 words
cases.rules_out: treating the lines as one word list, or mixing words between lines

cases.data: browser: Process multi-line text is checked at first, option on, 'one two\nthree four' typed in
cases.rules_out: a page that ignores multi-line when reversing words

not_covered: Skip empty lines or Trim whitespace combined with word reversal
multi-line off with several lines and word reversal on

cases.expect: 'dlroW olleH'; with reverseWords=true the same input gives 'World Hello'
cases.rules_out: an option that has no effect, or one that changes the default behaviour
a default of true for the new argument

cases.data: browser: type 'Hello World', then check and uncheck the option
cases.rules_out: a toggle that cannot be undone

not_covered: character reversal with Skip empty lines or Trim whitespace combined with the new option off
multi-line input with the option off

alerts: The service tests call stringReverser through a loosely typed reference, `(...args: unknown[]) => string`. The build runs `tsc` first, and five-argument calls fail to compile against the current four-argument signature, which stopped the browser server from starting. The cast can be removed once the fifth argument exists.
The browser tests find the option with getByLabel('Reverse word order'). This relies on the new option using the exact visible label 'Reverse word order', rendered like the existing checkboxes.
